# Scopes

The design decisions. Every scope answers the same five method questions, and has the same parts: the tokens it owns, the components it lands in and its situations. Each answer points back to the answers that pulled it.

## The five methods

| Method | What it asks |
| --- | --- |
| Roles | Which roles the scope needs. Each role becomes a group of decisions. |
| How many | How many steps, levels or variants each role gets. |
| How defined | The rule that produces the values: a scale, a base unit, a style or a policy. |
| Values | Where the values sit, as a word. The exact values live in the tokens. |
| Lands in | Where the scope does its most visible work in the product. |

## Typography

How text is set: roles, sizes and line height.

- **Owns tokens:** `type`
- **Lands in:** button, input, badge, table
- **Situations:** Page title, A number in a table, Paragraph or help text, Field label or column header

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | Which text roles does it need? | Core: heading, body, label · Core and data · Core and editorial display · Core and expressive display | `typography.roles` |
| How many | How many sizes does the scale have? | Few · Some · Many | `typography.count` |
| How defined | How are sizes and line heights defined? | A ratio, line heights on the grid · A ratio, line heights in proportion · Fixed steps | `typography.definition` |
| Values | How large is body text? | Small · Regular · Large | `typography.values` |
| Lands in | Where does type do the most work? | Tables and inputs · Articles and long text · Forms and labels · Headlines and hero | `typography.lands` |

## Color

How color carries action, state and brand.

- **Owns tokens:** `color`
- **Lands in:** button, input, control, badge, card, table, tabs, overlay
- **Situations:** A selected row or item, An error message, A link, A status, The action that completes the task, An alternative or cancel, Delete or remove

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | Which color roles does it need? | Surface, text, action and status · Those and brand accents | `color.roles` |
| How many | How many emphasis levels do actions need? | Two · Three · Four | `color.count` |
| How defined | How is the palette defined? | Neutrals and one brand ramp · Shared neutrals, a ramp per brand | `color.definition` |
| Values | How saturated is the palette? | Muted · Balanced · Vivid | `color.values` |
| Lands in | Where does color carry meaning first? | Status in tables · Links and actions · Brand moments | `color.lands` |

## Spacing

How space shows what belongs together.

- **Owns tokens:** `space`, `size.row`
- **Lands in:** button, input, badge, card, table
- **Situations:** Items that belong together, Between page sections, Table row height

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | Which spacing roles does it need? | Gaps and insets · Gaps, insets and row heights | `spacing.roles` |
| How many | How many densities exist? | One · Two | `spacing.count` |
| How defined | How are spacing steps defined? | A fine base unit · A coarse base unit | `spacing.definition` |
| Values | How dense is the layout? | Compact · Comfortable · Spacious | `spacing.values` |
| Lands in | Where does spacing matter most? | Rows and cells · Between paragraphs · Between fields · Between big sections | `spacing.lands` |

## Shape

Corners and borders.

- **Owns tokens:** `radius`, `border-width`
- **Lands in:** button, input, control, badge, card, overlay
- **Situations:** Corners of buttons and inputs, Shape of a status badge

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | Which shape roles does it need? | Controls and containers · Controls, badges and containers | `shape.roles` |
| How many | How many corner sizes exist? | Two · Three | `shape.count` |
| How defined | How are corners set? | Fixed for the product · Set by each brand | `shape.definition` |
| Values | What should control corners say? | Sharp · Slightly rounded · Rounded · Pill | `shape.values` |
| Lands in | Where does shape show most? | Controls in dense rows · Controls and cards · Buttons and badges | `shape.lands` |

## Elevation

When something rises above the page, and what separates groups.

- **Owns tokens:** `elevation`
- **Lands in:** card, overlay
- **Situations:** A card on the page, A menu or dialog

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | What rises above the page? | Only what floats · Cards too · Nothing | `elevation.roles` |
| How many | How many shadow levels exist? | None · One · Two | `elevation.count` |
| How defined | What separates groups on the page? | Space · Lines · Cards | `elevation.definition` |
| Values | How soft are shadows? | No shadows · Subtle · Soft · Pronounced | `elevation.values` |
| Lands in | Where does elevation show? | Menus and dialogs · Cards, menus and dialogs · Dialogs only | `elevation.lands` |

## Motion

What moves, why and how fast.

- **Owns tokens:** `motion`
- **Lands in:** transition
- **Situations:** Hover and press feedback, Someone asked for less motion

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | What is motion for? | Feedback only · Feedback and guidance · Feedback and expression | `motion.roles` |
| How many | How many speeds exist? | One · Two · Three | `motion.count` |
| How defined | How is easing defined? | Standard ease-out · A spring | `motion.definition` |
| Values | How fast does feedback feel? | Fast · Moderate · Relaxed | `motion.values` |
| Lands in | Where does motion show? | State changes only · State changes and panels · Hero and launch moments | `motion.lands` |

## Iconography

When icons appear and how they look.

- **Owns tokens:** `size.icon`
- **Lands in:** button
- **Situations:** An icon with no label, An action on one row or item

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | What do icons do? | Actions and status · Actions, status and navigation · Those and decoration | `iconography.roles` |
| How many | How many icon sizes exist? | One · Two | `iconography.count` |
| How defined | What icon style? | Outline · Filled · Two-tone | `iconography.definition` |
| Values | How big are icons next to text? | Match the text · Larger than the text | `iconography.values` |
| Lands in | Where do icons work hardest? | Toolbars and rows · Status and messages · Navigation · Buttons and calls to action | `iconography.lands` |

## Theming

Modes and brands.

- **Owns tokens:** `color.brand`, `font.family`, `radius.brand`
- **Lands in:** button, card, overlay
- **Situations:** Someone switches to dark

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | What can a theme change? | Mode only · Mode and brand · Mode and contrast | `theming.roles` |
| How many | How many themes ship? | Two · Several | `theming.count` |
| How defined | How are brands handled? | One brand · Brands as modes | `theming.definition` |
| Values | Which modes ship? | Light and dark · Light, dark and high contrast | `theming.values` |
| Lands in | What changes when the theme changes? | Colors only · Colors, type and shape | `theming.lands` |

## Accessibility

Floors the system must hold.

- **Owns tokens:** `size.control`, `opacity`, `color.border.focus`
- **Lands in:** button, input, overlay
- **Situations:** Keyboard focus, The smallest clickable thing

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | Which states get their own visible value? | Hover, focus, disabled · Those and pressed · All, including loading | `accessibility.roles` |
| How many | How many signals carry each meaning? | Two: color and word · Three: color, icon and word | `accessibility.count` |
| How defined | What contrast floor do we hold? | AA · AAA for text | `accessibility.definition` |
| Values | What is the smallest target? | Compact, for a pointer · Touch size · Large | `accessibility.values` |
| Lands in | Where are the floors hardest to hold? | Dense tables · Long text · Forms · Brand color | `accessibility.lands` |

## Naming

How tokens and keys are named.

- **Owns tokens:** `component`
- **Lands in:** button, input, control, badge, card, table, tabs, overlay, transition
- **Situations:** A value with no token

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | What gets a name? | Tokens · Tokens and component keys | `naming.roles` |
| How many | How many token tiers? | Two · Three | `naming.count` |
| How defined | How are decisions named? | By role · By component | `naming.definition` |
| Values | How are names written? | Lowercase words in paths · camelCase | `naming.values` |
| Lands in | What do components read? | Component keys · Semantic tokens | `naming.lands` |

## Voice and tone

How the product speaks: the words in every component.

- **Owns tokens:** `content`
- **Lands in:** button, input, overlay, table
- **Situations:** A button label, The words of an error, A success message, An empty state, A confirmation question, A first visit

| Method | Question | Answers | Id |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roles | Which kinds of copy does it need? | Labels and messages · Labels, messages and help · Labels, messages and articles · Labels, messages and headlines | `voice.roles` |
| How many | How many tones does it use? | One · One per moment · One per brand | `voice.count` |
| How defined | How is the voice defined? | Rules and a word list · Principles and examples · A shared core, brand tone on top | `voice.definition` |
| Values | How does it sound? | Terse · Plain and direct · Conversational · Playful | `voice.values` |
| Lands in | Where do the words matter most? | Errors and empty states · Articles and guides · Form steps and errors · Headlines and buttons | `voice.lands` |
